name: gsc
description: Search Analytics, URL Inspection and sitemaps from Google Search Console. Read-only; run gsc_oauth_start after install to authorise.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth client ID
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Desktop-app OAuth client from console.cloud.google.com. Shared with the ga4 plugin.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth client secret
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret of the same OAuth client.

GSC_SITE_URL.title: Default property
GSC_SITE_URL.description: e.g. sc-domain:example.com — otherwise pass siteUrl on every call.
